description: Regression for the TELEMON_MOVE_ISSUE save (R1 Movement, Custodes mirror). The Telemon's objective is obj_nml_1 to the north-east, it has a planned charge on the enemy Sentinel Guard Sodality Beta 19.1" away to the south-east, and a 3" solid gantry (gantry-38) is touching its base on the north-east side. Before: the move was bent 70% toward the charge target and then cut short by the threat dodge, so it went 5.4" south-east and gained ~0.2" on the objective. After: the charge steer is dropped (even 70% only ends 10" away, needs <=9"), the 100mm base's path is checked against the engine's 11e solid-terrain rule so it detours around the gantry, and the suggestion card lists every adjustment under 'How this turn's move was shaped'. Two-leg: the Telemon now doglegs around gantry-38 (1" sidestep, then on toward obj_nml_1) instead of a single 45-degree line; the decision carries _ai_model_waypoints, the card says it 'goes around it', and executing the move through AIPlayer stages the waypoint then the destination and the engine confirms it — the Telemon ends within 1" of obj_nml_1's terrain area (OBJ-GAP-2: measured to the area, which the move now aims at, not the marker dot).

steps.comment: what clicking the Telemon in the card's move order does

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("Planned charge on Sentinel Guard Sodality Beta is out of reach this turn")

steps.comment: OBJ-GAP-2: obj_nml_1 is a terrain objective — the planned destination ends within 1" of its AREA (the old check measured 8" to the marker dot; the move now aims at the area's nearest edge).
the AI's real execution path: waypoint staged, then destination, CONFIRM accepted by the engine
